summary: Members set a research question for a new group before asking it to report back.
realLife: The Senate created a select committee to investigate the 1972 presidential campaign. Its Watergate inquiry took testimony and pursued recordings before the committee issued its final report.
inGame: The study-formed situation and the legislature’s study committee record supply the charge.

turns.what: Members narrow the charge to the question their records can answer.
turns.pulledBy: The original request also covered an issue outside the group's authority.
turns.writesBack: The adopted charge names the narrower question and its reporting date.

turns.what: The group brings in its report after the council has already adopted the annual budget.
turns.pulledBy: The report depends on a survey returned after the budget vote.
turns.writesBack: The clerk puts its cost estimates in the file for the next budget hearing.
